title: Compact tutorial strip: SDK first-call + ephemeral key rotation
creator: Samir Clarke
description: Create a short horizontal tutorial strip (4 panels + optional micro-CTA card) that will be used in SDK and API quickstart docs. The strip walks a developer through: 1) creating an ephemeral API key from the Console, 2) making the first SDK call with that key, 3) receiving a streaming response with an inline progress indicator and token usage meter, and 4) a simplified visualization of tool calling (webhook/tool invocation arrow and result card). Deliverables: Figma file with components, exported SVGs/PNGs for docs, a set of light/dark variants, an accessibility pass (contrast tokens), and a mobile-optimized slice for the in-doc hero. Avoid duplicating existing auth/credential art; this should read as an explanatory micro-story (comic-strip style) rather than a literal screenshot series.
comments: 2026-03-10: Kickoff — aligned with PM on scope: single strip used in both SDK and docs landing. Decided 4 panels + CTA is optimal for screen real estate.
2026-03-11: Wireframes uploaded to Figma. Link posted in drive. Primary decision: show ephemeral key as a stylized chip rather than full key string to avoid sensitive-looking text.
2026-03-11: Engineering (Diego Ruiz) reviewed and requested explicit visual for 'reconnect on expired token' fallback in panel 3 — added micro-annotation.
2026-03-12: PM (Lina Morris) requested a smaller mobile slice for the docs hero and to include a short microcopy line explaining billing/usage. Added to acceptance criteria.
2026-03-12: Accessibility review queued — color tokens and focus states need confirmation before final exports.
2026-03-12: Design PR created for handoff: https://github.com/redwood/design-assets/pull/214 (contains SVGs and CSS spec)
Pending: final PM sign-off on copy and ENG confirmation of streaming indicator semantics.
review_feedback: PM: Keep copy to a single short sentence per panel; no more than 8–10 words. Emphasize 'fast start' and 'safe keys'.
ENG: Streaming progress should map to 'chunks received' not percent of tokens; add small pulse on token meter when caching occurs.
Security: Do not display full keys; use masked chip + 'rotate' affordance. Confirmed that mock key patterns are acceptable.
DevRel: Provide a small animated WebP for the docs hero to demonstrate streaming feel; keep static fallback for PDF/print.
export_specs: Source Figma file with component variants
acceptance_criteria: 1) Four-panel horizontal strip produced with light and dark themes
2) Figma components and tokenized colors provided in the project file
3) Final assets exported as SVG/PNG/WebP and included in design repo PR
4) Accessibility: color contrast >= 4.5:1 for body copy, WCAG focus states present
5) Engineering confirms streaming progress mapping and token meter semantics
6) PM approves microcopy and mobile slice
notes: This asset is intended as a compact storytelling element across docs and product UI. Keep language minimal and visuals developer-friendly (code + UI hybrid). Avoid exact replicas of Console screens — prefer conceptual UI that matches our brand and reduces churn when Console changes. Coordinate final handoff with DevRel for markdown placement and with Eng for telemetry iconography.
